query:
SELECT t.id, t.name, t.email, t.commissionRate, t.role, t.status,
       ti.token, ti.expiresAt, ti.usedAt
FROM technicians t
LEFT JOIN technician_invites ti ON ti.technicianId = t.id
  AND ti.id = (SELECT MAX(id) FROM technician_invites WHERE technicianId = t.id)
WHERE t.status IN ('invited', 'active')
ORDER BY t.id;
